description: Schedule 13D/13G reporting-owner records for an issuer, newest filing first. Structured XML filings from 2024-12-18 only. Free with no sign-in: AAPL, MSFT, JPM, KO, XOM, NVDA, AMZN, GOOGL, TSLA, LLY. Costs 3 credits. A figure can be withheld (null/absent beats a guess). A figure can change or disappear when a later filing arrives; figures are not versioned. Read `adjustments` for extractor decisions beyond copying one filed figure. This is filing data, not investment advice.
